question.problem:
Compute the volume $V$ of the parallelepiped spanned by the vectors $p=⟨1,2,3⟩$, $q=⟨0,5,1⟩$, and $r=⟨4,0,6⟩.$

$V=${{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The volume of a parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}p\cdot (q\times r) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 \\ 4 & 0 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 1 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 4 & 6\end{aligned}|+3\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ 4 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =1(30)-2(0\cdot 6-1\cdot 4)+3(0\cdot 0-5\cdot 4) \\  & =30+8-60 \\  & =-22\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we take the absolute value. So, the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is 

$$
V=|-22|=22.
$$
